message: Installed and populated mex scaffold for Ralph v2; root AGENTS.md now routes agents into .mex/ROUTER.md while CLAUDE.md remains a symlink.

Synced bundled skills to mattpocock/skills v1.1.0: to-spec/to-tickets replace to-prd/to-issues, wayfinder+research+code-review+grilling vendored, domain -> domain-modeling, tdd slimmed to red-green with seams and tautological-test anti-pattern. Preflight now pairs every implement-slice with a review-slice step (two-axis review + fix). Slices carry first-class blocking edges as native GitHub issue dependencies.

Split the post-implementation pipeline into final checks, PR creation, local QA preparation/execution, four-axis PR review, and always-run local-resource cleanup; removed per-slice review and review-fixes.

Slice #40: opt-in Claude collection uses configured foreground Agent definitions because live 2.1.263 hooks bind task packets and lifecycle; legacy Workflow and production completion remain unchanged.

Slice #42: opt-in Codex collection reads a finished exec parent's children through a fresh read-only App Server process (thread/list by parent and ancestor, thread/read with turns) and fails closed on unbound or inconsistent threads; live probe passed on Codex 0.153.4 with task_name identity and exposed worker model/effort. Legacy execution and completion remain unchanged.

Slice #41: one provider-neutral manifest verifier judges pr-review-v1 from collector evidence (five exact flat run-1 workers, retries are unexpected identities, nested descendants are flagged and uncounted, settings compared only with the requested worker, Claude aliases accept same-family canonical IDs, missing effective settings cap at OBSERVED); the PR-review prompt carries the task IDs and packet markers while provider fragments stay policy-free. Runner completion is unchanged until #44.

Slice #43: qa-v1 verifies an immutable parent-written QA plan (canonical Node SHA-256 digests over one documented checklist format that excludes checkbox/tag/Result/Evidence/summary progress), refetches the exact plan commentId (updatedAt never compared), and accepts one direct run-1 worker per assignment bound by digest (Codex task_name qa_r1_<hex>). Replacements are #46; runner completion is unchanged until #44.

Slice #46: qa-v1 accepts parent-owned QA replacement runs. Per assignment, direct workers of the current parent bound by digest and task ID must form runs 1..N (gap or missing run 1 = TASK_UNEXPECTED; duplicate run or completed lower run = TASK_DUPLICATED). The highest run is selected and must complete; lower non-completed runs are superseded. Nesting, parent, and model/effort checks apply to every run; observed counts cover selected children only.
